journal_lines: Old tunnel in the cave wall. Followed it. Found what the miners left behind.
Someone dug here and stopped. Their ore stayed. Taking it now.
Abandoned shaft. Cobwebs on the tools. The stone underneath still had ore in it.
Old pickaxe against the wall. Handle rotted off. The ore nearby was still good.
The cart rails led deeper than the map suggests. Followed them.
Someone left a torch holder here. Long dry. The ore they were near is still here.
The supports are original timber. Old-growth dark oak. The mine predates the maps.
Three generations of mining marks on this wall. Last batch was recent enough.
Found the ore they stopped for. Whatever stopped them didn't stop me.
The shaft angled into a seam someone started and never finished. Finished it.
Dusty chest at the end of the passage. They meant to come back.
The old survey line is still chalked on the wall. Followed it to the good stone.
